nom: RODAN + FIELDS Pure C Serum with 10% Ascorbic Acid

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including dry-sensitive combinations and those in dry winter or desert climates, generally say the thicker texture works well for them, leaving skin more moisturized and plumper rather than stripped.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who identifies as having combination skin says she initially disliked the oily-feeling texture but found no residual oiliness once it dried down, leaving her skin smooth.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea or reactive skin, are mostly positive, describing this as an unusually gentle vitamin C that didn't cause redness, stinging, or breakouts even at 10% ascorbic acid, especially when introduced gradually; a couple of reviewers with sensitive skin still report irritation, redness, or increased dryness and sensitivity even after cutting back frequency.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature, or who mention being in their 40s to 50s, say the serum softened fine lines and wrinkles and improved firmness and texture within two to eight weeks.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers who mention fine lines or wrinkles say they look softer and skin feels firmer and plumper within one to a few weeks of consistent use; a few reviewers, all early in their use, say they haven't yet noticed a change in lines or wrinkles and expect it may take longer.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, say the serum leaves skin more moisturized, plumper, and less dull, and multiple reviewers specifically say it did not dry their skin out despite expecting it might; three reviewers disagree, reporting the serum was very drying and, for one, made her skin drier and more sensitive even after cutting back to every other day.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, including one with rosacea and another whose pre-existing redness reportedly went away with use; several note a brief warming sensation, flush, or mild tingle right on application that fades quickly and isn't considered a problem, though one reviewer says the serum left her skin more sensitive and irritated even at reduced frequency.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers with dark spots, sun spots, post-acne marks or melasma say they visibly fade within three to eight weeks of regular use, including one whose melasma spots lightened and another whose long-standing uneven skin tone finally improved; a few reviewers say they haven't noticed any change in their dark spots or hyperpigmentation, though most of those had only used it briefly.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who mention breakouts say this serum hasn't caused new ones, including some who say they typically break out with new skincare or who layer it into an acne routine without issue, and one reviewer specifically noticed a reduction in visible blemishes on her cheek.

aspects.libelle: Feels oily on application but absorbs clean
Slow to absorb, can feel tacky or greasy after
Little product needed, bottle lasts a long time
Doubles as a smoothing makeup primer

extraits.texte: It's a pretty good serum. It didn't irritate my skin, which is very hit or miss with my skin and vitamin C products. It doesn't smell bad like many vitamin C serums do. It sinks in easily. My skin looked brighter. Those are the positives. However it didn't moisturize my skin at all. In fact, it dried my skin out a bit. Beyond the brightening, I didn't notice any of the other anti aging benefits promised. It might be better suited to those with oily skin, given the drying nature. I liked it okay but I wouldn't repurchase.

I really tried to like this product. It initially dried my skin out so I cut back to every other day. It made my skin very dry and sensitive despite cutting back on the frequency. It is also a very thick serum. I was given this product in exchange for an honest review but unfortunately it was not for me.

This was really great compared to other vitamins c products out there. I like the consistency and how it feels on the skin. My last vitamin c product left a sticky feel on my face so it was great to switch. I will say I have sensitive skin and so this caused some irritation. My advice is start slow, I am still only using this 2-3 times a week.

As a busy mom with mild rosacea, I'm super cautious with Vitamin C because a lot of serums can be irritating. This one surprised me in a good way. This Rodan + Fields Pure C serum feels much gentler and didn't cause redness or flare-ups for me. I did make sure to apply my moisturizer with an SPF afterwards. After a few weeks my skin looked brighter and more even, especially on tired days when I wasn't getting much sleep. There are no overnight miracles, but I definitely noticed I had a healthier and fresher look. I also like that it's lightweight and a little goes a long way. If you have sensitive skin and want a gentle Vitamin C that actually does something without irritation, this one has been a solid win for me and I definitely recommend you give it a try. I'm so glad I received this free sample to try and is now a part of my daily routine.

extraits.titre: A Must Buy and Try Serum
extraits.texte: I was able to try Rodan Fields Pure C serum free in exchange for my honest opinion. I really like how well it came packaged and the overall design of the serum bottle. Looks very new and modern. I have been using this in place of my Obagi vitamin C serum for close to 3 weeks and I have noticed my fine lines are fading faintly also I have a very nice glow and general plumpness back to face and cheeks. I also have a condition called melasma where I sufferer from unusual dark spots on areas of my face and this serum seems to have lighted some of my dark spots which I am very happy and grateful for. If your skeptical on trying I deff think pure c serum is worth a shot in fact I recommend the purchase and use of this product. I will continue to use and repurchase as needed. Thank you ❤️

I received a sample of Rowan & Fields Pure C Serum to try and review, and I was pleased with the results. The serum is thick, which was great for my dry skin, and yet it was easy to apply and two drops was enough. Immediately, I noticed my skin looked more moisturized and plumper. With continued use my skin became brighter, plumper, and smoother. My skin's texture was refreshed and there was a noticeable decrease in fine lines. The serum also didn't irritate my dry, sensitive skin. My only concern is if it will be too thick for use in the humid summer months, but so far it has been a great addition to my skincare routine.

extraits.titre: I would purchase  this item again !
extraits.texte: I really liked this product, it works really well for mature skin, it softens my fine lines and wrinkles, it adds a little brightness yo my skin, I've only been using for 2 weeks now. But it has made a big difference in my skin, it does take awhile to soak in to where you can continue with uour skincare routine,, but I have alot of time in morning to do my routine, and at night , so yeah I would buy this again, bcuz it's very effective for my mature skin.
